data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of $2,615.345m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows no material aggregate prior-year development for underwriting years up to 2020 (net movement ~ $0.0m), i.e. prior-year reserves were broadly unchanged. The 2022 year was, however, impacted by large reinsurance-to-close / loss portfolio transfer transactions added into the syndicate (gross reinsurance of new liabilities shown as $1,728.476m in the technical provisions note), which materially increased the total gross reserves during the year but do not represent prior-year development of the existing portfolio. The syndicate continues to cite claims inflation, late reporting and reinsurer credit as ongoing risks to reserve adequacy.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal risks faced by Syndicate 3500 arise from fluctuations in the severity of claims compared with expectations, late reporting of claims, inadequate reserving, claims inflation and inadequate reinsurance protection (including the credit worthiness of major reinsurers).
The most significant assumptions made relate to the level of future claims, the level of future claims settlements, the legal interpretation of insurance policies and the level of claims inflation.
The Board remain cognisant of the potential impacts of inflation and have undertaken work to quantify and mitigate its impact on these financial statements.
Syndicate 3500 is judged not to have material insurance exposure to COVID-19 related claims and has experienced limited claims notifications in this regard during 2020 and 2021.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) is not stated as a single gross movement in the notes. No explicit gross "movement in prior year's provision" figure was found. PYD was therefore computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims by underwriting year) which shows no aggregate change for underwriting years up to 2020 (calculated PYD = $0.0m). The 2022 figures are affected by large reinsurance-to-close / LPT transactions (note: gross reinsurance of new liabilities $1,728,476k) which increase opening/closing reserves but are not prior-year development of the existing portfolio. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from the report's $'000 presentation into millions.
